eo.label: Existence / Occurrence
eo.desc: Existence: ensuring all assets, liabilities, and equity listed in the statement of financial position actually exist. Occurrence: ensuring all transactions presented in the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income actually occurred.

c.label: Completeness
c.desc: Ensuring all transactions and accounts that should be presented in the financial statements are available and recorded in full.

a.label: Accuracy
a.desc: Ensuring amounts and other data related to recorded transactions and events have been recorded appropriately, and related disclosures have been measured and described appropriately.

co.label: Cut-Off
co.desc: Ensuring transactions and events have been recorded in the correct accounting period.

va.label: Valuation & Allocation
va.desc: Valuation: ensuring assets, liabilities, and equity are valued appropriately in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. Allocation: ensuring balances have been appropriately allocated between the statement of financial position and the statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income.

ro.label: Rights & Obligation
ro.desc: Rights: ensuring the company has rights to an asset at a certain time. Obligation: ensuring the company has obligations that are the responsibility of the company at a certain time.

pd.label: Presentation & Disclosure
pd.desc: Presentation: ensuring the classification of transactions and accounts is appropriately reflected in the financial statements. Disclosure: ensuring disclosures in the notes to the financial statements are adequate so that the financial statements are not misleading.

ipo.title: Information Processing Objective (IPO)
ipo.description: Map information processing objectives for this transaction-level control.

c.label: Completeness
c.desc: Ensuring all transactions/events that occurred have been recorded.

a.label: Accuracy
a.desc: Transactions/events are recorded with the correct values, accounts and periods. This also includes the accuracy of data entered into the system used in transaction processing.

v.label: Validity
v.desc: Only authorized transactions/events are truly recorded.

ra.label: Restricted Access
ra.desc: Data is protected to prevent unauthorized changes and access to confidential data and company assets can only be accessed by authorized persons.
